note: Voss's own baking recipes, written for this package. Vegetarian; eggs and dairy are welcome. Everything is weighed in grams, eggs included: they are weighed without their shells. The recipes were written with care, and nobody has yet baked them from this file: each stays marked untested until someone has, and says so.

recipes.name: Plain shortbread
recipes.tin: a 20 cm square tin, lined with baking paper
recipes.time: 35 to 40 minutes, until pale gold at the edges
method: Rub the butter into the flour, sugar and salt until it looks like damp sand, then press it together.
Press it evenly into the tin, prick it all over with a fork, and chill it for 20 minutes.
Bake it. Cut it into fingers while it is warm, and leave it in the tin until it is cold.

recipes.name: Pound cake
recipes.tin: a loaf tin of about 1 litre, buttered and lined
recipes.time: 55 to 65 minutes, until a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean

ingredients.item: eggs, beaten, weighed without their shells

method: Beat the butter and sugar until they are pale and light.
Beat in the egg a little at a time, with a spoonful of the flour if it starts to separate.
Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt, and scrape the batter into the tin.
Bake it. Leave it in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn it out onto a rack.

recipes.name: Soda bread
recipes.time: 40 to 45 minutes, until it sounds hollow when tapped underneath
method: Stir the flour, bicarbonate of soda and salt together, then stir in the buttermilk until a soft dough forms. Do not knead it.
Shape it into a round on the tray and cut a deep cross in the top.
Bake it at once, and cool it on a rack.

recipes.name: Oat biscuits
recipes.tin: two baking trays, lined with baking paper
recipes.time: 12 to 15 minutes, until golden at the edges and still soft in the middle

ingredients.item: egg, beaten, weighed without its shell

method: Beat the butter and sugar together, then beat in the egg.
Stir in the oats, flour, bicarbonate of soda and salt.
Roll the dough into balls, set them well apart on the trays, and flatten each a little.
Bake them. Leave them on the trays for 5 minutes, then move them to a rack.
